text:
Rae: kicking off a small canary for rwd-v3p0-quant4v3 on a subset of chat+summarize routes in ~10m. putting the provisional gates here for quick feedback :wave:
Luis: drop them inlined pls so ops can copy-paste the checks. also what's initial traffic percent?
Rae: canary traffic=1% for now. proposed checks: p95_tail_ms <= 1250; p95_delta_ms <= 200; hallucination_delta_pct <= 0.4; watched_slices = ["code_summary", "longdoc>2048", "customer_utterance_sensitive"]; slice_hallucination_threshold_pct = 0.2; min_samples_global = 3000; min_samples_slice = 400. autoback rules: if global_hallucination_delta > 0.4% -> full rollback; if watched_slice_hallucination_delta > 0.2% and slice_n >= min_samples_slice -> rollback that slice route; immediate rollback if error_rate > 0.5% or p95_tail_ms > baseline*2.
Priya: small nit: make hosted-prod p95_tail_ms 1100, else too risky for strict SLO endpoints. Dedicated can stay 1250.
Omar: quick AB snapshot from bench-bot (n=9.6k): accept_delta = -0.4% (ns), halluc_delta = +0.28% (p=0.06), code_summary slice: +0.8% (n=1.4k), longdoc>2048: +0.45% (n=620). median latency +15ms, p95 +75ms.
Luis: the longdoc slice n is only 620, below global min but above slice min; do we want slice_n to be 500 min? 400 seems tight.
Rae: will set min_samples_slice=500. good catch. updating.
qa-bot: smoke: unit=PASS(250/250) integration=PASS(120/120) fuzz=FLAG(6/250) -> 4 flags in code_summary responses, details: https://ci.internal/job/qq/4123
infra-bot: router: canary opened at 1%. fallback route pinned=rwd-v3p0-int8. kv_warmup ON for longdoc. autopromote=false.
bench-bot: concordance summary (24h rolling): precision drop concentrated on code_summary prompts with rare factual assertions. reproducibility 0.92.
Priya: recommend running targeted eval set for code_summary (3k prompts) before moving to 5% traffic. also try attention remap tweak in quant profile (scale=0.98) to see if hallucinations improve.
Omar: agree. also suggest adding an isolation watch: if a single route slice >0.5% halluc delta for 3 consecutive snapshots -> auto-cut that route (not global).
Rae: plan: 1) run 3k code_summary seed eval (new seed) 2) try remap scale=0.98 in a shadow run 3) after results, bump to 5% if slice deltas under thresholds 4) snapshot concordance & publish decision. I'll post updates here.
Luis: pax: when you snapshot, include p50/p95/p999 and error_type breakdowns. we need to see coldstart spikes.
Rae: will do. ping me if you want early logs. thanks all :pray:
